blocks.text: Print spooling manages print jobs sent to a printer. Documents are placed in a queue in order of arrival, so the first document sent is printed first and the others wait their turn. This prevents documents printing out of sequence or clashing when sent at the same time.

blocks.prompt: Three people send documents to one printer at 9:00, 9:01 and 9:02. Which prints first?
blocks.explanation: The 9:00 document, because the print queue is first in, first out.

items: Print spooling: print jobs wait in a FIFO queue and print in order of arrival.
